in_latin.name: Sylvestre
in_latin.long_meaning: Sylvestre significat silvam aut silvestrem locum. Derivatur a Sylva, quae significat silvam aut silvestrem locum. In early Christian church, Sylvestre significat virum qui vivit in silva aut in silvestre loco. Sylvestre est nomen viri qui vivit in pace aut in silvestre loco.
